alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.
alerts.query_hint: TDF renal function monitoring creatinine schedule

alerts.title: Creatinine not monitored for >12 months on TDF
alerts.message: TDF is nephrotoxic and requires routine creatinine monitoring. The patient's only creatinine result is from 2024-10-01, which is 478 days (over 15 months) before this visit. No creatinine was ordered today. The latest value of 88 umol/L was normal, but no recent renal function assessment is available to detect TDF-related nephrotoxicity. DTG can also affect renal tubular secretion and may contribute to creatinine elevation. The absence of any recent creatinine data represents a significant monitoring gap for a patient on TDF-containing ART.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and urinalysis for renal function monitoring. Ensure creatinine is checked at least every 6-12 months for patients on TDF.

alerts.title: Viral load 40 copies/mL near detection threshold
alerts.message: The patient's viral load on 2025-10-01 was 40 copies/mL, which is near the lower limit of detection. While values below 50 copies/mL are generally considered suppressed, a value of 40 copies/mL warrants close attention as it may represent low-level viremia. The clinician's plan documents 'no issues' without noting this result. Repeat viral load testing should be considered to confirm sustained suppression, as persistent low-level viremia may indicate adherence challenges or emerging resistance.

evidence.recommended_action: Repeat viral load in 2-3 months to confirm sustained suppression. Assess adherence and potential drug interactions if low-level viremia persists.

alerts.title: ADR screening not documented at this visit
alerts.message: Guidelines state that for each encounter, all health workers should screen for suspected ADRs using the Drug Safety Screening checklist. The clinician's plan today documents 'Routine follow-up. No issues' with no evidence of structured ADR screening. DTG is specifically listed among drugs requiring neuropsychiatric symptom screening. The patient reports no complaints, but guideline-directed screening should be actively documented.

evidence.recommended_action: Complete and document the Drug Safety Screening checklist at every encounter, including neuropsychiatric symptom assessment for DTG.
